name: Askino
author: askino

sections.description:
Askino is an AI-powered chat widget that can be enabled on your WordPress site in just a few steps, so visitors get instant answers from your AI agent.

With this plugin you can:

  • Connect the Askino AI widget to your site using a Public Key
  • Use the settings page in English, Persian or German, following your WordPress language or chosen manually
  • Customize the widget’s position, size, and display behavior
  • Enable or disable full-screen display on mobile devices
  • Disconnect or reconnect the widget at any time

To create an account and set up your AI agent, visit askino.net.

External services

This plugin relies on the Askino service to provide its AI chat widget functionality. It connects to Askino’s servers in two ways:

  • Connection check (admin area only): when you submit your Public Key on the plugin’s settings page, the plugin sends that Public Key (a GET request) to the Askino API to verify it and retrieve your Widget ID. The language of the plugin (for example en-US) is sent in a Language header. No personal visitor data is sent at this step.
  • Widget script (public-facing): once connected, the plugin loads the Askino chat widget loader script from the Askino CDN on every public page of your site, passing your Widget ID and Public Key so the widget can render and let visitors chat with your AI agent. Conversations that visitors have with the widget are handled directly by Askino’s servers, not by this plugin.

Service addresses used by this plugin: https://askino.net and https://askino.chat (API, path /api/v1.0/widget/integration/wordpress/{public_key}/), and https://cdn.askino.net and https://cdn.askino.chat (widget script, path /widget/widget-loader.js).

This service is provided by Askino (“Askino AI”). By using this plugin you agree to Askino’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin under wp-content/plugins/ or upload it through the WordPress admin.
  2. Activate Askino from the “Plugins” menu.
  3. Open the Askino settings page from the WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. (Optional) Choose the plugin language at the top of the settings page. By default it follows your WordPress language.
  5. Copy your Public Key from the Askino dashboard and paste it into the settings field.
  6. Click “Connect and activate widget.”
sections.faq:
Where do I find my Public Key?

From the Askino dashboard, under your agent’s settings.

Which languages does the plugin support?

English, Persian and German. By default the plugin follows your WordPress language, and you can change it manually from the language selector on the settings page.

Can I change how the widget looks?

Yes. From the plugin settings you can change the widget’s position, width, height, and button size.

Does this plugin send any data to an external server?

Yes. See the “External services” section on this page for full details.

1.1.0

  • New: language selector (default, Persian, English, German) on the settings page.
  • New: German translation.
  • Improvement: all strings are now translatable (English source strings).
  • Improvement: input validation and hardening of the connection and widget loading code.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
